summary: Second miner run for this lens after the usage-limit stop of 2026-10-09. 89 facts added this run (all mech-pass, 0 rejected and not repaired): 16 global-infrastructure (3 quota facts, 6 pricing-principle facts, 3 PoP facts, 2 Regions-table rows, 1 billing code, 1 pop isolation), 12 global-infrastructure Region launch change facts (doc-history rows 2022-08-29 to 2025-09-02), 27 well-architected (six pillars, 6 pillar definitions, 5 availability table rows, availability and nines definitions, RTO, RPO, RTO vs MTTR, DR vs availability, 5 document-revisions change rows, 2 lens announcements), 21 management-console (multi-session, Private Access, Local Zones selector, Global View map, Region visibility, 11 CloudShell quotas and behaviors under the management-console key), 7 aws-cli, 6 budgets (home chapter 41). Files: facts-numbers-02..06.json, adopt-*.json, adopt-plan.json.

conflicts_queued_by_this_run.note: All are M12 false positives left for the adjudicator: rows of one table with different numbers (availability tiers 99.95/99.99/99.999; Region launch rows), and cf-0018 pairs the docs page ('up to five identities') with the What's New post ('up to 5 sessions'), same value. Resolve with --both.

d002.not_found: The headline counts (124 AZs within 39 Regions, 7 more AZs and 2 more Regions announced, 750+ CloudFront POPs and 15 Regional edge caches, 46 Local Zones and 33 Wavelength Zones) stand on www/about-aws/global-infrastructure and regions_az only as a single '###' heading line (M8 forbids a lone heading) or as a label and a number on separate lines (M4 cannot place them on one line). The overview whitepaper (docs/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/global-infrastructure) states no counts and points back to the landing page. The fault-isolation whitepaper sentence 'over 410 PoPs, including more than 400 Edge Locations, and 13 regional mid-tier caches' ends in a Markdown link (M3). Writers must give these counts without a number or request a fact after a page with the counts in prose is found.

d007.not_found: No sentence on docs/global-infrastructure/latest/regions/aws-regions explains how a Region code is formed; the table (Code, Name, AZs, Geography, Opt-in status) is adoptable row by row (table 0) when a writer needs another Region.

d011.note: Twelve Regions opened between 2022-08-29 and 2025-09-02; the Regions guide counts 34 for an AWS account. Any 2022 prep material quoting a count is out of date.

d033.not_found: POP and Regional edge cache counts: see d002. The purpose of a Regional edge cache is not on docs/whitepapers/latest/aws-fault-isolation-boundaries/points-of-presence (searched 'edge cache', 'regional edge cache'); it belongs to the CloudFront chapter (developer guide 'HowCloudFrontWorks').

d043.note: Global View map view GA 2026-08-12: not examinable yet (note on the fact).

Writers can name the formats without a fact link only as a 'no-fact' marked list, or a registrar can request a page that states them in plain prose.
